verdict.rationale: Zero's own MCP.md documents an MCP server whose tools cover the whole loop: reading and searching threads, triage (labels, mark read/unread, archive, delete), drafting, and sending drafts or new emails. However, the connection is thin: authentication means copying a browser session cookie into an Authorization header, OAuth is only 'coming soon', and the docs are a prose capability list with no endpoint schema. Missing for 10: OAuth or another standard auth flow for agents like Claude and ChatGPT, a schema or reference documentation for the MCP tools, and independent hands-on corroboration of end-to-end agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an external agent — Claude, ChatGPT, or my own — can read, triage, draft, and send my email end to end through a documented connection
